title: Long multi-road journeys could exhaust supplies to 0/8 on arrival… @ unmapped
excerpts: Long multi-road journeys could exhaust supplies to 0/8 on arrival despite the described anti-shortage stop rule
Overworld long-distance travel (Rome to Oswego, 8-road route)
